svg.font-family: GxInter, Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: graphos capabilities
svg.desc: graphos is a multi-tenant property-graph service: PostgreSQL 18 with Apache AGE 1.8 behind a typed HTTP API. Your services, the Python client, the web UI and curl call graphos-api over HTTP with a bearer token; graphos-api checks tenant access, validates typed contracts, builds SQL itself under statement timeouts, runs background jobs and emits metrics, logs and an audit trail; only it reaches PostgreSQL, where each tenant is its own AGE graph. Build: tenants and schema, writes and data transfer, composable reads, rule-derived edges. Explore: graph map and aggregates, graph algorithms (Louvain, PageRank, betweenness, components, degree), an opt-in read-only Cypher console, and the web UI. Run: identity and access with single sign-on, a change feed with revisions, operations, and the Python client.
svg.text: A multi-tenant property-graph service: PostgreSQL 18 + Apache AGE 1.8 behind a typed HTTP API.
